args.lesson: Bounded STOP. 100 saved Manager forum posts were scanned and 35 matched keywords. The observed pain is header-name mapping ("Gross amount" vs "Gross"), one-row-per-line-item layout and the platform batch format. None of these are structural defects the checker detects, and the saved guide file is empty (136 chars of navigation). What worked: parsing the nested search JSON into a compact hit file and reading blurbs before designing content. What failed: earlier turns built the checker before matching it to the observed pain. Next: do not create more CSV acquisition content. If CSV continues, any reframe must target header and mapping checks for one platform, and it needs a fresh source with an actual guide body. Otherwise let the 19 Nov window run and put effort into a different opportunity.
